what: One photo is split into 7×5 pieces. The first six pieces float in from far depth (z −1500, .2×, blur +40px) over 2.7s natureSway(0.08,0.494,0.14,1) to scattered positions (x −645~220%, y −240~245%, z −2270~252, blur 0·12px, opacity .8) and hover there. Scrolling the pinned section (scrub 1.5) snaps the six into place over 3.5s power3.inOut, and the remaining pieces fly in from 3.4s in a set order over 3s power3.out to form one image. Once all are attached, the picture panel widens to full screen width (100%) over 4s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1). Put a video in that panel and it becomes the featured video.

options.delay: Initial wait before flying in (sec), default .5
options.scrub: Seconds of lag when following scroll, default 1.5
options.end: ScrollTrigger end, default bottom bottom — the attached element height (e.g. 650vh) is the scroll length
options.widen: if off, the panel is not widened
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Board where the pieces gather (inside the position: sticky stage). It will widen, so whoever uses it sets the initial width
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Image to split (photo, video, placeholder) — a copy goes into each piece

note: When everything gathers and the board widens, it emits the fx:gathered event (detail.dir 1 going down · −1 going up) — hook video playback to this
